cues: Big data is data so large, so fast, or so varied that ordinary database tools cannot handle it in time.
The standard answer is the five Vs.
Variety, tables mixed with logs, photos and voice.
Veracity, how much of it is wrong.
And value, the insight you can extract.
text: Big data is data so large, so fast, or so varied that ordinary database tools cannot handle it in time. The standard answer is the five Vs. Volume, the sheer quantity. Velocity, the speed it arrives. Variety, tables mixed with logs, photos and voice. Veracity, how much of it is wrong. And value, the insight you can extract.
